name: Brown Bear
publisher: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Adventurers League
author: Greg Marks
encounterHeading: Part 2, Do You Have Any Candy?
sourceAccess: Read the 2016 local adventure and visually checked the relevant folio. The linked full-text corroborates the adventure version.
errataEvidence: No official correction for this standalone adventure block was located.
operationalEvidence: Printed p. 30 gives both Bite figures and +5 to hit for each attack. The encounter sidebar on p. 14 specifies both uses of the bear.
sourceDiscrepancies: The Bite line prints 8 (1d8 + 8). The average and the dice expression disagree. Use the printed fixed 8 for a direct reading and retain the recorded dice wording. The 2014 Monster Manual errata changes that book’s Brown Bear to +6 to hit. This adventure prints +5.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description based on verified reused art. Adventure-specific morphology is recorded in the encounter prose.
habitatEvidence: Tags from the printed encounter location.
